name: New Source Corporation
description: Distributor of aluminum extrusions in standard shapes, including I-beam, channel, and bar profiles. Alloy 5052 and 6061 available with pre-painted and anodized finishes for structural, construction, and architectural applications. Cutting and custom lengths offered.

name: Precision Metals and Engineering LLC
description: Manufacturer of aluminum for the aerospace, marine and ground defense industries. Grades include 1100, 2024, 2219, 5083, 5086, 5456, 5059, 6061, 7039, 7075 and 7178. Additional services such as heat treating, non-destructive testing, ultrasonic inspection, gun drilling, chemical milling, circle cutting, shearing and boring available. Meets MIL-DTL-46027, MIL-DTL-46083, MIL-DTL-32262 and MIL-DTL-46063 Spec.

name: Continental Steel & Tube Co.
description: Distributor of aluminum bars, angles, and channels for aerospace, automotive, medical, marine, military, and construction industries. Some products are available in 1.5 in. length and 0.25 in. thickness. Slitting, shearing, annealing, polishing, warehousing, re-packaging, painting, grinding, heat treating, and galvanizing are offered as secondary services. Suitable for recreational and petrochemical applications.

name: Aluminum Distributing, Inc. d/b/a ADI Metal
description: Wholesale distributor of aluminum including aluminum master alloys. Available in different shapes and sizes (metric and imperial). Aluminum alloys include 535 cast, 3003, 5052, 5083 marine-grade, 5086 marine-grade, 6061 structural-grade and 6063 architectural-grade alloys. Available in product forms such as angles, bars, rods, sheets, pipes, tubes, beams, mouldings, plates, planks, channels and gratings. Alloys are used in military, marine, government agencies, shipbuilding, oil/gas, construction and industrial applications. Custom lengths and anodized or powder coated finishes can be special ordered. Packaging services and same day delivery available for most orders. Meet ASTM standards.

name: Aerospace Alloys, Inc.
description: ISO 9001:2008 and AS9100 C certified manufacturer and distributor of aluminum and aluminum alloys. Types of aluminum grades also include 2219, 2014, 2017, 2024, 2219, 3003, 3004, 5052, 5086, 6061, 6063, 7050, 7075, 7175 and 2618. Aluminum alloy products include coils, bars, plates, tubing, sheets, pipes, extrusions, forgings and wires. Aluminum alloys feature corrosion resistance and are suitable for aircraft structures, rivets, connectors and hydraulic valve bodies and screw machine applications. Stock items also available. Meets AMS, PWA, UNS, ASTM, GE, EN, AISI and HS specifications. Kan Ban programs. JIT delivery.

name: Accumet Specialty Metals, Inc.
description: Distributor of aluminum alloys for aerospace, automotive, defense, energy, food, medical, and petrochemical industries. Available in bar, sheet, plate, and wire forms. Aluminum forgings and castings are available. Heat treatment, boring, grinding, turning, cutting, sawing, and shearing are provided as secondary services.

name: Industrial Alloys, Inc.
description: Distributor of aluminum for automotive, construction, military, textile, OEM, and transportation industries. Available in channel, square, coil, strip, flat, beam, plate, and tubing forms. Angles, bars, sheets, rods, and round or rectangular shapes are also provided.

name: Metalmark
description: Distributor of prime & secondary aluminum. All types of aluminum are available including 1100, 1145, 1350, 2024, 3003, 5005, 5050, 5052, 5054, 6061, 7075 & 7475. Aluminum alloys are available in all tempers, finishes, types & sizes. Products include sheets, coils, plates, bar & tube. Also buy & sell prime, secondary, obsolete & surplus metals.

name: Aerometallo LLC
description: Distributor of aluminum for the aerospace industry. Available in plate and rectangular bar forms. Meets AS9120 standards. NADCAP certified.

name: Lawrence & Frederick, Inc.
description: Distributor of aluminum alloys for automotive, architectural, appliance, decorative, lighting, electronics, nameplate, and other industries. 1100 H14, 1000, 3000, and 5000 series anodized aluminum are offered. Anodizing, slitting, sheeting, shearing, blanking, vinyl masking, and adhesive laminating services are provided as secondary.

name: Paragon Steel
description: Distributor of aluminum. Aluminum is available in various grades, sizes & finishes. Capabilities include processing, fabricating, flame cutting, forming, cutting, punching, shearing, slitting, beam splitting, welding, coating, notching, bending, drilling, installation, material testing, shoring, packaging & marketing. JIT & 24/7 delivery.

name: Clingan Steel
description: Manufacturer of aluminum coils, straps, strips, and rolls. Made from 1050, 1100, 1145, 1200, 3002, 3003, and 3105 grade aluminum materials. 5005, 5082, 5086, 6061, 6063, and 7075 aluminum shapes are also provided. Available with painted, mill, satin, right, and Kynar® surface finish. Suitable for automotive, electrical, stamp hardware, house ware, military, and decorative parts. Capabilities include edging, decembering, oscillate winding, slitting, skiving, rolling, and tempering services. Serves technical stampers, display or spring manufacturers, wire formers, and steel industry. Meets ASTM standards.

name: Commercial Metal Exchange
description: Distributor of aluminum alloys in rod, plate, sheet, coil, strip, bar, and tube forms. 1100, 2011, 2024, 3003, 5052, & 6061 aluminum alloys are offered. Applications include automotive, art sculpture, construction, military, marine, roofing contractor, and machine shop. Meets ASTM, ASME, and SAE standards.

name: Custom Aluminum Products, Inc.
description: Custom aluminum extruder. 6000 series of alloys in 7 in., 8 in., & 10 in. circle sizes. Three extrusion presses, complete in house fabrication, paint, powder coat, anodizing, assembly, bending, welding & precision CNC machining. Serves the commercial & industrial sectors.

name: Palmer Holland, Inc.
description: Distributor of conventional and spherical atomized aluminum powder and flakes. Suitable for automotive and coating applications. Serves the rocket motor, chemical, and metallurgical industries.

name: R.D. Mathis Company
description: Manufacturer of high purity aluminum materials in pellet, wire, rod, slug and sheet or plate forms. Available in various sizes and purities. Aluminum canes and clips are available. Other materials include chromium, cobalt, copper, germanium, hafnium, indium, iron, nickel, silicon, silicon dioxide, silicon monoxide, tantalum, tin, titanium, titanium oxide, zinc and zirconium. Gold, palladium, platinum and silver metals are also available.

name: Service Chemical, Inc.
description: Suppliers of aluminum powders, industrial chemicals, & military specification chemicals. Wide range of purities & particle sizes. Milling & screening processes available.

name: AirMetals
description: Supplier of 1100, 3003, 5052, 6061, 6063, 5086, 7178, 7050 and 7075 aluminum alloys for aerospace industry. Available in various sizes and in round, square, hexagonal and octagonal shapes. Sheet, strip, plate, rod, bar, tubing and ring forms are also offered. Secondary services include deburring, honing, grinding, polishing, heat treating, laser cutting, anodizing, chem-milling, water jet cutting, lab testing, export packaging, mechanical testing and gun drilling. Meets AS standards.

name: Johnson Bros. Roll Forming Co.
description: Manufacturer of roll formed aluminum. Available in channels, rods, bars, angles, sections, profiles, and tubing. Comes with pre-painted, chromate galvanneal, black oxide, vinyl laminated, and pre-lacquered finishes. Suitable for furniture, partition, display, rack, filter, and refrigeration applications. Serves the agriculture, aircraft, architectural, construction, HVAC, and military industries. Made in the USA.

name: Tri-State Aluminum
description: Custom manufacturer of aluminum including 6005, 6105, 6061, 6063, 6463 & specialty aluminum alloys. Aluminum is available in various shapes including bars, angles, channels, beams, tees, hexagons, pipes, tubes & front & flush glaze systems & accessories. Capabilities include anodizing, painting, fabricating, cutting, drilling, tapping, CNC machining, assembly, stamping, turning, MIG & TIG welding, bending, surface grinding & conditioning. Various applications include building & construction, aerospace/defense, fixtures, marine, displays, signage, advertising, automotive, fencing, scaffolding, tent poles, doors, windows, electrical components, flooring, decking, shower enclosures & picture framing. On-time delivery.

name: O'Neal Steel, Inc.
description: Distributor of aluminum material for construction machinery, communications equipment, sign, truck, trailer and motor vehicle body manufacturing industries. Available in 3003, 5052, 6061 and 6063 grades. Offered in angle, channel, beam, plate, sheet, pipe, tube and flat, round, hex or square bar forms. Secondary services include metal forming, sawing, shearing and plasma, oxy-fuel or fiber laser cutting.

name: Atlantic Equipment Engineers, Inc.
description: ISO 9001:2015 certified. Manufacturer of alloys made from 6061, 7075, and 6061 grade aluminum. Available in granular particles of nodular or spheroid form. Melting point ranges from 477 to 1220 degrees C. Features vary depending upon model, including high strength, fatigue, and corrosion resistance. Blanket delivery and analytical services provided. Suitable for chassis, wings, fuselages, powder metallurgy, cans, planes, paints, pigments, inks, and colorants. Serves the aerospace, aviation, automotive, marine, beverage, food, nuclear, fuel source, military, and defense industries. Custom shapes and sizes are also offered. Meets DOT standards.

name: All Metal Sales, Inc.
description: Distributor of aluminum available in bar, disc, sheet, rod, wire, tube, pipe, foil, and plate forms. Serves sciences, aerospace, energy, military, and petrochemical industries. ITAR registered.

name: Amtek Tool & Supply
description: Distributor of aluminum in shim form. Available in 0.001 to 0.125 in. thickness, 24 or 100 in length, 6 and 24 in. width. Applications include tool and die set up, alignment, assembly, mounting of motors or pumps, machine repair and maintenance. Serves the automotive, aerospace, government, optical, medical, military, manufacturing, fabrication, tool and die industries.

name: Arnold Magnetic Technologies
description: Manufacturer of ultra-thin aluminum alloys in strips, foils, shapes, and strips. Available with 0.0025 to 0.635 mm thickness and 101.6 to 444.5 mm width. Suitable for batteries, cable, component shielding, packaging, pharmaceutical, and electrical applications. Serves the aerospace, defense, automotive, electric and hybrid motors, medical devices, oil and gas, alternative energy, and consumer electronics industries. Meets AS9100D standards. NADCAP certified.

name: Cadence Supply Company
description: Distributor of 2024 and 6061 aluminum alloys for the aerospace, food processing, packaging, oil and gas, medical, and alternative energy industries. Offered in sheet, rod, tube, ball, and strip forms. Stock items available.

name: Mid South Aluminum
description: Distributor of polyester and PVDF painted coils made from 1100, 3003, and 5052 aluminum. Suitable for roofing, wall panel, canopy, column cover, window, door, screen frame, starter strip, and flooring applications. Serves the architectural, building, construction, automotive, cargo trailer, and rainwear industries.

name: American Nickeloid Company
description: Manufacturer of aluminum coils and sheets available with a baked epoxy resin finish, clear or simulated yellow or red brass coating. Can also be laminated and pre-painted. Specifications include .008 to .097 in. thickness, 12 to 60 in. width, up to 60 in. OD, 16 to 24 in. ID and a maximum size of 24,000 lbs. Applications include sand urns, nameplates and mirrors. Features include lightweight, rustproof, highly corrosion resistant and workable. Heat resistant up to 150 degrees F. Suitable for salt air, outdoor and indoor applications. Serves the automotive, vending, electronics, appliance, housewares, hardware, and architectural industries. Blanket order releases, Kanban, and JIT shipping offered.

name: Joseph Fazzio, Inc.
description: Distributor of aluminum. Available in the form of beams, plates, flat sheets, pipe, and square or round tubing bars. Stock items available.

name: Trinity Brand Industries, Inc.
description: Manufacturer of temper annealed and adhesive backed 1100 and 1235 aluminum. Available in sheets and rolls. Sheets come in 152.40 to 1219.20 mm length, 50.80 to 609.60 mm width. Thickness ranges from 0.0254 to 3.1750 mm. Sheets are welded, brazed and corrosion resistant. Suitable for chemical equipment, heat exchanger fin, railroad tank car and sheet metal work applications. Meets ASTM standards. RoHS, REACH and DFARS compliant. Made in the USA.

name: Nathan Trotter & Co., Inc.
description: Manufacturer of standard & custom aluminum. Available in bar, ingot, shot & powder forms with 99.999% purity. Capabilities include extrusion, casting, alloying, melting & scrap recycling.

name: United States Brass & Copper
description: Supplier of standard and custom aluminum alloy mill products. Offers standard coils and sheets and custom rods, bars, tubes, and pipes. Custom mill products are available in various sizes and shapes. Capabilities include edge conditioning, sawing, re-rolling, blanking, traverse winding and deburring, plating, engraving, etching, packaging, precision shearing, slitting, and up to 25000 pieces per hour production cutting.

name: Metals Unlimited Aerospace
description: AS 9100 certified stocking distributor of aluminum. Aluminum is available in various grades and sheets, plates, rods, bars, extrusions and tubing. Applications include metalworking and aerospace industries.

name: Boston Centerless
description: ISO 9001:2015 certified custom manufacturer and distributor of aluminum. Aluminum alloys such as 1100 series alloys, 2011 series alloys, 2024 series alloys, 2017-T4 alloys, 2017-T451 alloys, 6061-T6 alloys, 6061-T6511 & 7075 aluminum alloys are available. Aluminum is available in different grades & bar, flat or tubing form. Capabilities include centerless grinding, heat treating, straightening, saw cutting, bar end chamfering & inventory management. Material testing, Kanban & JIT delivery services are available.

name: Southern Tool Steel, LLC
description: Distributor of aluminum. Aluminum is available in such configurations as rod wire, bar, sheets & plate as well as pipe & tubing. Offered in non-heat treatable & heat treatable alloy configurations. Heat treatable types are also available as brazing sheets & tooling plates. Other materials that are used include copper alloys, brass, bronze, titanium, stainless steel & alloy steels.
